design.title: 16B primary plus three lazy secondaries
design.before: Monomorphic primary cannot retain four alternating shapes.
design.change: Same separated path with three secondary entries and first-empty then round-robin replacement.
design.cost: More secondary probes and retained shapes; primary remains16B.
